apfsds_t.notes: Measured on the game engine (tools/arma/dump_physics.sqf): shells of Sh_120mm_APFSDS_Tracer_Red launched at 1670 m/s at many elevations, the range and time at which each crosses the launch height and +-50 m. Elevation is the low trajectory over flat ground relative to the muzzle; the table ends where the gun elevation limit (20 deg) or the shell lifetime stops the shot. dElevPer100m and dTofPer100m are the change per 100 m of height difference (same sign convention as the in-game artillery tables).
